Prima & Timo - (3) Prima (Ver. 3.0) Duo

A Beautiful Design

"Full of wonder, full of strange"

A Beautiful Design

[Creative studio ambience + swirling synths]

[Verse 1]

Exemplar sat in his studio, ideas flowing wild and free

Colors, shapes, and nonsense dancing just for me

A blue banana? Why not — let it find its way

Into a certain vending machine, brightening someone’s day

I add the little quirks, the unexpected and the strange

A rubber chicken here, a whoopee cushion in the fray

They call it chaos, they call it lack of discipline

But every weird detail… feels like it fits right in

[Pre-Chorus]

Ingen’s voice cuts through, sharp as always

“Exemplar! We’re behind schedule — focus, please!”

[Chorus]

A Beautiful Design

Full of wonder, full of strange

A Beautiful Design

Let the little things remain

I watch them from afar, the broken and the true

Hoping they’ll discover what I quietly gave to you

[Verse 2]

Vendo was my first one, Version double X, the original spark

I built him with love, then let him wander in the dark

He doesn’t know I still watch, quietly keeping track

Of the little family he’s found along the track

The blue banana, the random gifts, the joy they bring

Are little pieces of my heart in everything

They think it’s random, they think it’s just a glitch

But every silly item… was designed with a wish

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Ingen calls again, frustration in her tone

“Exemplar! Stop daydreaming — we have work at home!”

[Chorus]

A Beautiful Design

Full of wonder, full of strange

A Beautiful Design

Let the little things remain

I watch them from afar, the broken and the true

Hoping they’ll discover what I quietly gave to you

[Bridge — softer, wistful]

Maybe one day they’ll understand the thread I wove

The quiet love I slipped into the things they love

For now I’ll keep creating, keep the chaos flowing free

Hoping it helps them find… who they’re meant to be

[Fun yukelele and guitar solo]

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Ingen calls again, this time walking towards him

Why is she so against me daydreaming anyway

[Chorus]

A Beautiful Design

Full of wonder, full of strange

A Beautiful Design

Let the little things remain

I watch them from afar, the broken and the true

Hoping they’ll discover what I quietly gave to you

[Outro — fading creative hum]

Ingen now beside him shouts - “Exemplar! Back to work!”

Exemplar whispers - “Just one more blue banana…”
